sensor_inputs: two nonnegative finger-contact readings interpreted as normal force
enable_conditions: bilateral contact above detection threshold, persistent for configured contact_persist_s
force_hold_contract.target_definition: minimum_hold_normal_force_N = finger_kp * min(maximum_compression, mass*g*safety/(2*sqrt(mu_body*mu_finger)*finger_kp)); derived from existing assumptions, not measured load capacity.
force_hold_contract.only_new_feedback_rate_bound: total-opening decrease <=contact_approach_speed*dt (2mm/s;33.333um at a regular60Hz tick). This does not bound original ramps/first-contact candidate or actual material displacement.
force_hold_contract.only_new_feedback_total_bound: maximum_force_feedback_closure=2*maximum_compression=.6mm in the configuration, referenced to first freeze across loss/recontact. It is not total gripper compression, collision penetration or a bound on every source of target change.
force_hold_contract.no_widening_by_feedback: upper=min(frozen,previous);lower=min(upper,...), so this feedback branch cannot enlarge a smaller existing legal command.

explicit_release_contract.priority: Logical widening enters opening-ramp branch before bilateral force feedback, clears preload reference/confirmation; low cap below preload disables new force feedback. Merely reducing a cap while it remains above the preload is not alone a release command.
explicit_release_contract.slew_enable: Only when prior force_preload_adjusted is true and a subsequent explicit logical widening starts. Untightened and legacy effort=None paths remain original.
explicit_release_contract.per_step_rule: positive scheduled_delta/dt updates release speed;applied=min(current_ramped,previous+speed*dt). A paused schedule may catch up only to current ramped, never an undelivered future logical target.
explicit_release_contract.finish_rule: Both actual applied target and current ramped must reach logical end before release_slew is cleared.
explicit_release_contract.closing_reversal: Explicit logical closing reversal exits release state; it is not silently treated as continuing release.
explicit_release_contract.idempotency: Exact repeated(t,logical,ramped,previous,fingers,forces,effort) returns cached output without additional motion.
explicit_release_contract.not_a_universal_opening_speed_limit: This rule follows caller scheduling increments; it does not add a new global fixed release speed or certify measured joint motion.

EXTRACT_orientation_contract.nominal_teacher_rotation: ParentEXTRACT calls_feedback(...orientation=False), so its orientation correction is skipped. New teacher suppressesGRASP orientation; _enter does not replace rotation. Nominal rotation_command is therefore held throughEXTRACT untilTRANSPORT default orientation feedback resumes.
EXTRACT_orientation_contract.still_active_truth_XY: EXTRACT still supplies source_initial[:2] asdesired_cup_xy; _feedback98-105 adds bounded truth XY correction to the smooth nominal target. No change of orientation flag disables this position correction.
EXTRACT_orientation_contract.still_active_robot_tracking: Task109-122 applies robot-state-only position/rotation bias after nominal reference. Tracking98-101 uses exp(rotation_bias)*nominal_rotation; update residual uses previous applied-command FK vsactual robot orientation. A fixed nominal orientation need not mean an identical effective IK quaternion.
EXTRACT_orientation_contract.not_claimed: No actual rotation amplitude/onset/cause is assigned from source. Contact dynamics, drive response and frame/reference definitions require aligned requested/nominal/effectiveIK/FKactual/nativehand/cup records in the separate closed physical audit.

finite_conclusions: Compared withc793, additional preload is sensor-based and conditional, not a force-cap/gain/friction increase or a teacher macro.
Low nonzero bilateral contact can now request further bounded tightening despite the former frozen logical target, but this does not guarantee grasp success.
Release slew avoids jumping across an earlier feedback correction by following the actual opening schedule, not by binding/freezing the object.
Seven physical/acceptance groups and all three scorers are byte/value unchanged across these fixed commits. No physical-calibration or all-assets-global-hash claim is made by this source-only review.

EXTRACT nominal teacher orientation was already held in this fixed config. Calling a later observed rotation EXTRACT teacher orientation feedback is unsupported without distinguishing still-active XY and robot tracking layers.
